raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 13 sent merchant_id in a new 'M-0NNN' format (e.g. 'M-0139') instead of the plain integers used by every other batch, so the strict INTEGER cast fails. There are 80 distinct values against 40 merchants (100-139), and the samples (M-0139, M-0135, M-0123) are zero-padded versions of the same IDs, so stripping the 'M-' prefix recovers the correct key. This format change is undocumented and should be reported to the source team.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(regexp_replace(trim(merchant_id), '^M-', '') AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
